caption:
Wholesale and distribution businesses often buy in bulk and sell on trading terms to other businesses, creating a double cash-flow challenge, cash tied up in stock, then tied up again waiting on customer payment. Invoice finance and stock finance are commonly used together here.

Every industry has its own rhythm when it comes to cash flow and finance needs, understanding wholesale and distribution businesses's specific pattern is the first step to finding the right fit.

Wholesale and distribution businesses often face a double cash-flow squeeze, stock first, then trading terms, that combined finance can address.
